missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Зелёный' takes the masculine ending to match 'карандаш'. The desk scene anchors the colour form in daily life.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Зелёная' takes the feminine ending to match 'сумка'. The simple description fixes the feminine colour form in mind.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Зелёное' takes the neuter ending to match 'яблоко'. The everyday food image roots the neuter colour form.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Зелёные' takes the plural ending to match 'листья'. The spring scene fixes the plural colour form.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative agreement. After 'по', 'зелёному' takes the masculine dative ending to match 'парку'. The walk grounds the oblique colour form.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental agreement. After 'за', 'зелёной' takes the feminine instrumental ending to match 'изгородью'. The garden scene anchors the oblique case.
Strategic focus: Masculine genitive agreement. After negated 'нет', 'зелёного' takes the masculine genitive ending to match 'шарфа'. The phrase shows the genitive in everyday use.
Strategic focus: Plural accusative agreement. 'Зелёные' matches inanimate plural 'деревья', so the accusative mirrors the nominative. The drawing scene roots the plural form.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Зеленее' is the comparative of 'зелёный' and stays the same for any gender. The sentence compares this year's grass to last year's.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental in the predicate. After 'стал', 'зелёным' takes the masculine instrumental ending to match 'светофор'. This shows the становиться-plus-instrumental pattern.
